title: UPS Haslet robotic system not responding; AGVs out of sync and small sort stopped

site.notes: Case and CBRE evidence point to Haslet/Fort Worth TXRTH site, while one RMS screenshot appears to show Alliance, TX. Preserve as location ambiguity.

kpi_tracking.basis: Use CBRE/work-order entry time as the source-supported tracking start and the Salesforce close comment stating the site is running as the tracking end.

symptoms: Nothing was moving at the site.
Robotic system was reported as not responding.
AGVs were reported out of sync.
RMS/HMI showed a mostly blank screen with message '.NET Control not created.'
WCSWebApplication and application errors were visible around 6:35-6:36 AM.
OptiSweep service termination event was recorded at 6:36 AM.
incident_description: High-priority production incident at the UPS Fort Worth/Haslet site where the robotic system stopped responding and site operations reported that nothing was moving. Evidence shows OptiSweep service termination at about 6:36 AM, concurrent WCSWebApplication/application errors, AGVs going out of sync, and abnormal RMS/HMI behavior. Troubleshooting included Event Viewer review, Ignition gateway restart activity, service-state checks, API validation checks, and RMS review of AGV state. Case comments indicate the OptiSweep service was reset, out-of-sync AGVs were corrected in RMS, and the site resumed auto bag-out before later being reported as running.
customer_operational_impact: Production was seriously impacted. The small sort was not running, bots were not moving in various areas, totes could not be removed from hospital, and the site shifted to manual bag-out during part of the incident.
systems_involved: Windows Event Viewer / Service Control Manager
what_resolved_it: Source-supported recovery actions indicate the OptiSweep service was reset, RMS was used to locate and correct out-of-sync AGVs, and the site resumed auto bag-out. Later review evidence states the site was running at case close. Memory/log-size follow-up for the faulted web application was noted but not confirmed as the definitive incident fix.
follow_up_required: SME review of whether memory usage and log growth were contributing factors for the faulted web application.
Confirm exact operational recovery time from original Salesforce close comment evidence.
Review location ambiguity between Haslet/Fort Worth and Alliance, TX references.
Review whether removed or out-of-sync AGV conditions require separate corrective tracking.
support_boundary: Support evidence spans warehouse controls/application support, service/application diagnostics, RMS/AGV state review, and customer/work-order coordination. Root cause is not conclusively established in the extracted evidence.
